description: Begin recording what happens in a tab: clicks, scrolls, keystrokes, form fills, selections and navigations, each with a timestamp. Returns {recording, sessionId, tabId} — keep the sessionId, since every other recording tool needs it. Requires the T3rnel Browser extension. Recording stops on its own if the tab closes or after four hours.

maxEvents.description: Maximum events to keep, oldest dropped first (default 10000)

sessionId.description: Recording session id; one is generated when omitted

tabId.description: Tab to record; uses the active tab when omitted

name: session_record_start
